annotation.kind: source selection, tier label, exact finite-vector paraphrase, and minimal algebraic assumptions

assumptions: The computed residual equals the exact residual plus the residual-computation error.
The next stored iterate equals the old iterate plus the computed correction and update-rounding error.
No nonsingularity assumption is needed for this exact identity.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P03 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.
conditions.N: The fixed statement and P03 shared files are present; no NumStability artifact is present.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p03_t1_one_step_residual_identity {n : ℕ} (A : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ) (x d Δx b rHat Δr y : Fin n → ℝ) (hres : ∀ i, rHat i = b i - p03MatVec A x i + Δr i) (hupdate : ∀ i, y i = x i + d i + Δx i) : ∀ i, p03MatVec A y i - b i = Δr i + p03MatVec A d i - rHat i + p03MatVec A Δx i
formal_statement.plain_language: The new residual after one rounded refinement update is exactly the sum of the residual-computation, correction-solve, and update-rounding terms.

informal_proof: Expand the updated iterate inside A, then replace the computed residual by the exact residual plus its computation error and collect terms.
